staging_environment.note: Approved non-production FxA/Sync endpoint IDs are never guessed. The architecture owner must supply the staging endpoint GUIDs and test-account policy approval; until then dependent sync work stays blocked.
staging_environment.account_isolation: two ephemeral staging accounts, revoked after the matrix

test_account_policy.secrets_source: CI secret environment variables only; never arguments, logs, or artifacts
test_account_policy.cleanup: revoke both accounts and erase simulator keychains even on failure
test_account_policy.proxy_trace: host/URL metadata only; no content, token, or key bytes

role_registry.authority: approves the contract, staging environment IDs, and trust anchors
approves engine, transport, and secret-handling evidence
approves account isolation and proxy-trace privacy evidence

policies.fxa: FxA/Application Services sync15 path only; never direct Sync REST or raw tokens in app code
policies.e2ee: encrypted by the sync15 engine; content never leaves the encrypted record in plaintext
policies.retention: staging accounts and traces deleted after each matrix run; artifacts retained 7 days
policies.reset: reset flows go through the engine authority; never destructive local deletion without explicit user action
policies.rollout: staging-only; production enablement is a separate post-plan authorization
policies.migration: fixture-driven migration; unknown payload fields preserved byte-for-byte
